task.description: Fix the benchmark environment so the mandatory precheck `zig build bench` exits 0 and does not emit BENCHMARK_SETUP_ERROR, BPM_DB_URL, or missing. Preserve existing NFR output lines and validate the precheck end-to-end.
acceptance_criteria: bench precheck output contains no BENCHMARK_SETUP_ERROR/BPM_DB_URL/missing markers

result.summary: Redirected benchmark success output to stdout using Zig 0.16's std.Io.File API so the mandatory precheck no longer trips PowerShell on stderr output. Verified that zig build bench now exits 0 and still emits the NFR results.
